title: Pure Supreme King
summary: Supreme King cards plus the four Dimension Dragons they call for by name, with generic staples; the Pendulum Magician and Predaplant partners from the page are left out. Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm searches a Supreme King Gate and revives itself onto an empty board. Supreme King Gate Magician summons itself and searches a card that mentions Supreme King Z-ARC. Wings of Light searches any Supreme King Dragon or Gate. On the opponent's turn, Soul of the Supreme Celestial King tributes Gate Magician to Fusion Summon Z-ARC by banishing its materials from the Deck and Extra Deck, and Z-ARC destroys every card they control. Z-ARC keeps its effects only if a Pendulum Dragon, Xyz Dragon, Synchro Dragon and Fusion Dragon are banished. That is why Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Clear Wing Synchro Dragon and Starving Venom Fusion Dragon are here. Supreme King Dragon Starving Venom is Forbidden. Starving Venom Wing Dragon is left out: the page builds it through Predaplant and keeps it in the Side Deck.

allow.Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon: The Pendulum Dragon that Soul of the Supreme Celestial King banishes so Z-ARC keeps its effects.
allow.Clear Wing Synchro Dragon: The Synchro Dragon that Soul of the Supreme Celestial King banishes so Z-ARC keeps its effects.
allow.Starving Venom Fusion Dragon: The Fusion Dragon that Soul of the Supreme Celestial King banishes so Z-ARC keeps its effects.

main: Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm
Starter: searches a Supreme King Gate; revives itself onto an empty board.
Supreme King Gate Magician
Summons itself and searches a card that mentions Z-ARC; the Spellcaster Soul of the Supreme Celestial King tributes.
Supreme King Dragon Lightwurm
Tuner: recovers a Supreme King Pendulum from the Extra Deck and Synchro or Xyz Summons.
Supreme King Gate Zero
Scale 0: summons a Fusion or Synchro Dragon from the Extra Deck; searches a Fusion Spell.
Supreme King Gate Infinity
Scale 13: summons an Xyz or Pendulum Dragon from the Extra Deck.
Supreme King Dragon Odd-Eyes
Tributes two Supreme King Dragons to summon itself; searches a small Pendulum.
Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon
The Pendulum Dragon for Z-ARC; searches a small Pendulum.
Wings of Light
Quick-Play: searches a Supreme King Dragon or Gate, or summons Z-ARC.
Pendulum Evolution
Trades a Pendulum for a 2500-ATK one; lets Z-ARC attack every monster.
Soul of the Supreme Celestial King
Tributes Gate Magician to Fusion Summon Z-ARC on their turn.
Soul of the Supreme King
Pays half your LP to summon Z-ARC; turns it into the four Dimension Dragons.
Miracle of the Supreme King
Swaps Z-ARC for an Odd-Eyes, or sets a Pendulum or Quick-Play Spell.
Supreme Rage
Summons up to four Supreme King Dragons alongside Z-ARC.
extra: Fusion boss: destroys every card they control when summoned; can't be targeted or destroyed by them.
Newest: becomes Z-ARC on the field; summons two Supreme King Dragons after a kill.
Level 8 Synchro: wipes their face-up monsters when Synchro Summoned.
Rank 4 from DARK Pendulums: steals ATK; returns two Pendulums in battle.
The Synchro Dragon for Z-ARC: negates a Level 5 or higher monster's effect.
The Xyz Dragon for Z-ARC: halves a monster's ATK.
The Fusion Dragon for Z-ARC: copies a big monster's effect.
Generic Synchro Dragon: negates a monster effect.
